reports.title: Bristol Myers Squibb Reports Third Quarter Financial Results for 2026 and Raises Full-Year Revenue Outlook

guidance.heading: Financial Guidance
section: Bristol Myers Squibb is increasing its full-year, non-GAAP revenue guidance from a range of approximately $49.0 billion to $50.0 billion to a range of approximately $49.75 billion to $50.25 billion. This update primarily reflects broad-based and continuing momentum across the portfolio.
Full-year other income/(expense) is now expected to be ~$650 million of expense, due to favorable net interest.
Non-GAAP EPS is being updated to an anticipated range of $6.35 - $6.55, which is inclusive of a $(0.60) impact from Acquired IPRD and licensing income.

July(Prior) | October(Updated)
Total Revenues(Reported & Ex-FX) | ~$49.0 - $50.0 billion | ~$49.75 - $50.25 billion
Gross Margin % | ~69% - 70% | No change
Operating Expenses3 | ~$16.5 billion | No change
Other income/(expense) | ~($700 million) | ~($650 million)
Effective tax rate | ~18% | No change
Diluted EPS | $6.75 - $7.00 | $6.35 - $6.55
Acquired IPRD Charges & Licensing Income Included in Diluted EPS | $(0.02) | $(0.60)
